attention.note_en: Macro/policy/geo news flow right now — coincident backdrop, NOT a theme trigger. Heavy attention RAISES the bar (hype = late), it does not lower it.
attention.note_zh: 当前宏观／政策／地缘新闻流 — 同步背景，而非主题触发。关注越热门，门槛越高（炒作=偏晚），不会降低门槛。

narratives.name_zh: 跨板块集群 · Information Technology + Industrials
narratives.why_en: 13 names moving together (avg pairwise correlation 57%), co-movement tightening (+0.33 vs the prior window) — the signature of a narrative forming. Not yet in any basket (overlap 46%). Cohort down 18% over the window.
narratives.why_zh: 13 只个股同步运动（平均两两相关性 57%），共动正在收紧（较前一窗口 +0.33）— 叙事正在成形的特征。尚未纳入任何篮子（重叠 46%）。区间内组合下跌 18%。
caveats_en: Detection is noisy — roughly half of flagged clusters become real, persistent themes.
Early-entry return edge is ≈0 and negatively skewed; this is a watchlist / avoid-the-peak tool, never a front-run signal.
Recommended tickers are ranked by clean ENTRY (least-extended first), not by expected return — they are where to LOOK, not what to buy.
This cluster's sector sits under a currently-hot macro narrative — elevated attention RAISES the bar (late-entry risk).
caveats_zh: 检测有噪声 — 约半数被标注的集群最终会成为真实、持续的主题。
早期入场的回报优势≈0 且负偏；这是观察清单／避免追高的工具，绝非抢跑信号。
推荐个股按干净入场（最不拉伸者优先）排序，而非按预期回报 — 是该看哪里，而非买什么。
该集群所属板块正处于当前热门的宏观叙事之下 — 关注升温抬高门槛（偏晚入场风险）。
